name: TAPP Composition Module: Group1 (Procedure Identification)
abstract: The shared procedure-identification block composed into all sixteen TAPP tables of the 2026-08-11 library (Module_Group1.csv, v3). Seventeen fields, every one mapping to a property that already exists on tappDefinition or adaProduct, so this is a PROFILE rather than a set of definitions: it asserts which base properties a conforming procedure or analysis carries, and which are required. Two $defs because procedure and analysis are separate documents here - a TAPP schema composes ProcedureIdentification, a technique detail schema composes AnalysisIdentification. Requiredness derives from the module's own tier columns via the TAPP tier matrix.
